title: Extraction by selection among candidates
description: Pick the right value among candidates found in a text (which phone number, which amount, which date part), or verify an extracted field

field.description: what the value is, as an exact stated fact, e.g. 'the number the customer asks to be called back on'

candidates.description: {value, description} per candidate (how it differs); 'not_stated' is added

extra.not_stated: the text does not state it

combine: selected if value != 'not_stated' and value.p >= select_p; not_stated if value == 'not_stated' and value.p >= select_p; review otherwise
limitations: counting, sums and date arithmetic stay in code (direct counting spreads over 5-10 values); dates are read as components
the model selects, it does not confirm offsets
code must check that the chosen span is a substring of the text (signals.value)
a flat answer (p_top below 0.3) is review: do not act
notes: # deviation: spec 5.11: the question id is the fixed `value` (the verified u11 asks it as `callback`) and the not_stated text is generic; candidates is an array of {value, description}; decisions are ordered not_stated, review, selected so that a review does not end the run before the retry; the 0.4-0.7 retry is one re-read with think 256 and samples 2 that replaces the first read, and an answer still below 0.7 is review
